stem: The vertices of the triangle PQR are the points P(1, 2), Q(4, 6) and R(− 4, 12). Which one of the following statements about triangle PQR is true?

options.label: A
options.text: PQR is a right triangle with the right angle ∠P.

options.label: B
options.text: PQR is a right triangle with the right angle ∠Q.

options.label: C
options.text: PQR is a right triangle with the right angle ∠R.

options.label: D
options.text: PQR is not a right triangle.
